goals.goal: Personal data held by the company (customer account metadata and task data containing personal data of customers' users) is retained for no longer than is necessary for its declared processing purpose; any retention beyond purpose end is lawful and subject to Art. 89(1) safeguards (pseudonymisation, aggregation, access limitation); the RoPA documents the envisaged time limits for erasure per data category.
goals.adjustment: Narrowed to the company's two data classes (customer account metadata; task data with personal data of customers' users); no sensitive-data categories; processor role for customer task data acknowledged; no AI/ML logs in scope.

goals.goal: Security updates and supporting advisory messages for the company's SaaS product remain available to users across the support period (≥ 5 years) and the 10-year-or-remainder-of-support-period update-availability tail; Annex II information remains accessible for at least 10 years from placing on market; the support-period end-date is communicated clearly and understandably at the time of purchase.
goals.source: Art. 13(8); Art. 13(9); Art. 13(18); Art. 13(19); Annex I Part II (7); Annex I Part II (8)
goals.adjustment: Narrowed to the company's SaaS product (web + mobile interface) as a default-class product with self-assessment conformity; no AI/ML systems; the 10-year tail applies to update artefacts and Annex II information, not to personal data.
